propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nested pytest invocations with duplicate logic for basetemp, timeout, cache plugin and env settings.

Three sites lack --basetemp: test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py (executes integration nodes), test_git_version_floor.py (collect-only), and test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py (collect-only).

A centralized run_nested_pytest helper in tests/_nested_pytest.py must consolidate subprocess.run calls while preserving per-site divergences (timeouts, flags, args) and enforcing --basetemp under tmp_path.
The env parameter must be forwarded byte-identically to subprocess.run without merging onto os.environ, to preserve security test oracles that pass minimal mappings.
Exactly fourteen nested-pytest launch sites exist under tests/, verified by AST scan for list/tuple literals containing sys.executable, -m, pytest in sequence; all must migrate to the helper.
The helper must propagate subprocess.TimeoutExpired unmodified and return CompletedProcess by identity, with timeout reaching subprocess.run as a keyword argument.
